srs: The hotel reservations system records Guest, Reservation, ReservationService, and Room; each has an id attribute. Each Guest can have zero or more Reservation records, and each Reservation belongs to exactly one Guest. Each Reservation uses exactly one ReservationService, and each ReservationService serves zero or more Reservation records. Each ReservationService manages one or more Room records by composition, and each Room belongs to exactly one ReservationService. Each Guest can reference zero or more Room records, and each Room can be referenced by zero or more Guest records.
